title: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
1. Short title and commencement ‑‑(1) This Order may be
called the High Court of West Pakistan (Establishment) Order, 1955.
(2) It shall come into force on
the fourteenth day of October, 1955.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Definitions

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
2. Definitions.‑In this Order, unless the context otherwise
requires,‑
(i) "Bench" means any
Bench consisting of one or more Judges of the High Court of West Pakistan ;
(ii) "Chief Justice"
means the Chief Justice of the High Court of West Pakistan and includes an
Acting Chief Justice of that Court ;
(iii) "Circuit Court"
means any Bench of the High Court of West Pakistan sitting or holding Court at
any place in the Province of West
Pakistan other than Lahore, Karachi or Peshawar ;
(iv) "Judge" means a
Judge of the High Court of West Pakistan and includes an Acting or Additional
Judge of that Court ;
(v) the term "specified
territories" shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Establibhment of
West Pakistan Act, 1955.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Establishment of the High Court of W.P.

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
3. Establishment of the High Court of West Pakistan.‑(h) As
from the commencement of this Order there shall be established a High Court of
Judicature for the Province of West Pakistan, to be called the High Court of
West Pakistan (hereinafter referred to as the High Court), and the High Court
of Judicature at Lahore, the Chief Court of Sind, the Judicial Commissioner,
Court in the North‑West Frontier Pro vince and Baluchistan, and any other
Court functioning as High Court in relation to the territories or areas now
included in the Province of West Pakistan shall cease to exist.
(2) The High Court shall have
such original, appellate and other jurisdiction and such powers and authority
in respect of the territories included in the Province of West Pakistan as the
High Court of Judica ture at Lahore had, immediately before the commencement of
this Order, in respect of the territories in relation to which it exercised
appellate jurisdiction.
(3) The High Court and the
Judges and divisional Courts thereof shall sit at Lahore, but the High Court
shall have Benches at Karachi and Peshawar and Circuit Courts at other places
within the Province of West Pakistan, consisting of such of the Judges as may
from time to time be nominated by the Chief Justice.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Chief justice to have power to transfer proceedings and to assign areas to the benches

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
4. Chief
Justice to have power to transfer proceedings and to assign areas to the
Benches.‑(1) The Chief Justice shall have power to make provision for
all or any of the following matters, that is to say‑‑
(a) assigning areas to the
Benches at Karachi and Peshawar in relation to which each Bench shall exorcise
jurisdiction vested in tom High Court;
(b) transferring proceedings
pending immediately before the com mencement of this Order in‑
(i) the High Court of
Judicature at Lahore ;
(ii) the Chief Court of Sind ;
(iii) the Judicial
Commissioner's Court in the North‑West Frontier Province;
(iv) the Judicial
Commissioner's Court of Baluchistan ;
and
(v) any other Court functioning
as High Court in any other specified territory ;
to, the High Court or to a Bench at Karachi or
Peshawar or to a Circuit Court; and
(c) for all matters incidental,
supplemental and consequential thereto.
(2) The Chief Justice shall
have power to determine what cases and what classes of cases shall be disposed
of by the Judges nominated to Circuit Courts.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Original civil and criminal jurisdiction of the bench at Karachi

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
5. Original civil
and criminal jurisdiction of the Bench at Karachi.‑ Notwithstanding
anything in this Order or in any other law for the time being in fore, the
Bench of the High Court at Karachi shall have the same original civil
jurisdiction for the civil district of Karachi and the same criminal
jurisdiction and powers of the Court of Sessions for the Sessions Divisions of
Karachi, as were exercisable, immediately before the commencement of this
Order, by the Chief Court of Sind under section 8 of the Sind Courts Act, 1926
(Sind Act VII of 1926)
Provided that the Governor‑General
may by notification in the official Gazette direct that, as from a specified
date such jurisdiction and powers as are mentioned therein shall cease to be
exercisable by that Bench and as from that cate that Bench shall cease to
exercise that jurisdiction and powers.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Appointment of Judges

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
6. Appointment
of Judges.‑(1) The Chief Justice and the Judges of the High Court of Judicature at Lahore holding their
respective offices immediately before the commencement of this Order shall, as
from such commencement, hold their respective officers in the High Court on the
same terms and conditions as were applicable to them immediately before such
commencement.
(2) The Chief Judge and every
Judge of the Chief Court of Sind and the Judicial Commissioner and every Judge
of the Judicial Commis sioner's Court in the North‑West Frontier Province
holding office immediately before the commencement of this Order shall, as from
such commencement, hold office as Judge of the High Court;
Provided that a temporary or
additional Judge appointed under section 222 of the Government of India Act,
193$ (26 Geo. 5, ch. 2), to any of the Courts mentioned in paragraphs (1) and
(2) of this Article shall, on transfer, hold his office in the High Court until
the expiration of the period of his appointment.
(3) The Governor‑General
shall determine the order of seniority of the Judges transferred to the High
Court under paragraphs (1) and (2) of this Article.
(4) For the purpose of pension
and leave the Chief Justice and every Judge transferred to the High Court under
paragraphs (1) and (2) of this Article shall be entitled to count the period of
service spent by him in the Court from which he has been transferred in
accordance with the rules applicable to him in that Court.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Transfer of clerks and ministerial officers

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
7. Transfer of clerks and ministerial officers.‑Every clerk
or minis terial officer serving immediately before the commencement of this
Order in any Court mentioned in paragraphs (1) and (2) of Article 6 shall, as
from such commencement, be deemed to be the clerk or ministerial officer, as
the case may be, of the High Court and shall be entitled to the same terms and
conditions of service as were applicable to him immediately before such
commencement Provided that every such person shall be liable to serve in or
under the High Court in any post or capacity determined by the Chief Justice.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Seal of the Court

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
8 Seal of the Court.‑The
High Court shall have and use, as occasion may arise, a seal bearing a device
and impression of a crescent moon with horns pointing upwards surmounted by a
star, and the said seal shall be delivered to and kept in the custody of the
Chief Justice, and in case of vacancy in the office of the Chief Justice, the
same shall be delivered over and kept in the custody of the person appointed to
act as the Chief Justice, and whensoever the office of the Chief Justice or of
the Judge to whom the custody of the said seal be committed is vacant, the High
Court shall be, and is hereby, authorised and empowered to demand, seize and
take the said seal from any person or persons whoso ever by what ways and means
soever the same may have come to his, her or their possession.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Application of letters patent

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
9. Application of Letters Patent.‑The Letters Patent
constituting the High Court of Judicature at Lahore for the Provinces of the
Punjab and Delhi dated the 21st March, 1919, shall apply to the High Court and
the jurisdiction, powers and authority conferred by the said Letters Patent on
the High Court of Judicature at Lahore shall be deemed to have been conferred
on the High Court of West Pakistan, and the said Letters Patent shall in their
application to the High Court of West Pakistan be road subject to such
modifications and alterations as the provisions of the Establishment of West
Pakistan Act, 1955, or any Order made thereunder, or any other law for the time
being in force may warrant.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Advocates, vakils, etc. Enrolled in High Courts of specified territories to be advocates, vakils, etc. Of the High Court

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
10. Advocates, Vakils, etc., enrolled
in High Courts of specified
territories to be Advocates, Vakils, etc., of the High Court.‑Unless the High Court otherwise determines
any person, who immediately before the commencement of this Order was an
Advocate, Vakil, Pleader or Attorney entitled to plead or act in any High Court
in a specified territory shall be deemed to be an Advocate, Vakil, Pleader or
Attorney of the High Court and shall be entitled to plead and act in the High
Court.

sections.shortTitle: High Court of West Pakistan Establishment Order 1955
sections.description:
Delegation of powers

G
G.‑G's O. XIX OF 1955
HIGH COURT OF WEST PAKISTAN (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER,
1955
11. Delegation of powers.‑The Chief Justice may from time to
time by order delegate all or any of his powers and functions to any Judge of
the High Court and may in like manner withdraw all or any of such functions and
powers.

of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937.‑The Government of India
(High Court Judges) Order 1937, shall apply to the High Court and the said order
shall, as from the commence ment of this Order, be amended as follows:‑
(a) in sub‑paragraph (1) of paragraph (2)‑
(i) the definition of
"Chartered High Court" shall be omitted; and
(ii) for the definition of
"Chief Justice" the following shall be substituted :‑
" `Chief Justice' means a
person appointed as Chief Justice of the High Court in accordance with the
provisions of the Government of India Act, 1935 (26 Geo. 5, ch. 2);".

Fourth Schedules the following Schedules shall be substituted :‑
